title: Xitshembiso Lexi Vuriweke Ehenhla Ka Embers
intro: U yima etlhelo ka ndzilo wa mananga loko madzovo ya wona ma hangalasiwa hi vukheta. Vaendzi va fika va ta hlangana eka ku miyela, naswona rungula rin’we ri pfula xitori xa xitshembiso, ku hlamala ni vumundzuku lebyi nga si hetisekaka.
clues: Hi tsemakanye mpfhuka leswaku hi ya fika eka nandza wo tshembeka emananga.
Hi kombele leswaku ku hangalasiwa swibalesa leswaku ku lunghiseleriwa ndzilo.
Hi vulavule ni un’wana loyi a a huwelerile langavi leswaku a titimela ni ku hlayiseka.
Hi tise mahungu ya n’wana loyi a ha ku velekiwaka eka munhu loyi a hundzeke malembe ya ku va ni vana.
Hi thye n’wana loyi a tshembisiweke vito ra Isaka.
Hi tise mahungu yo tsakisa ya n’wana wa mufana eka Ibrahim, naswona mahungu yo hlamarisa ma siye Ibrahim a hleka.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Tintsumi Leti Tiseke Mahungu Yo Tsakisa Ya Isaka eka Ibrahim
Tintsumi Leti Lemukiseke Lut
Tintsumi Leti Rhwaleke Swiluvelo
Tintsumi ta Tihele
Tintsumi Leti Rhumeriweke eka Nowa
identity.answer: Tintsumi Leti Tiseke Mahungu Yo Tsakisa Ya Isaka eka Ibrahim

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku tisa mahungu yo tsakisa ya ku velekiwa ka Isaka eka Ibrahim
Ku tsundzuxa Luti emahlweni ka ku xupuriwa ka vanhu va yena
Ku tivisa ku velekiwa ka Yahya eka Zakariyya
Ku rhwala Xiluvelo hi Siku ra Vuavanyisi
Ku tivisa ku velekiwa ka Isa eka Maryam
trial.answer: Ku tisa mahungu yo tsakisa ya ku velekiwa ka Isaka eka Ibrahim

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka
options: Ndzilo lowu lunghiseleriweke hi ndzilo lowu hangalakeke
Ngalava leyi papamalaka ehenhla ka mati ya ndhambi
Bako leri pfaleriweke hi ribye leri rhendzelekaka
Ntshava ya vumba leyi nonon’hwisiweke hi brine
Xitepisi lexi hangalakeke xi ya exibakabakeni
location.answer: Ndzilo lowu lunghiseleriweke hi swibalesa leswi hangalakeke

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Mahungu lama tsakisaka ya n’wana la vuriwaka Isaka
Mahungu yo tsakisa ya n’wana wa mufana loyi a vuriwaka Yahya
Ku hlawuriwa ka Talut tanihi mufumi ehenhla ka Vana va Israyele
Xilemukiso xa le mahlweni ka ku xupuriwa ka vanhu va Lut
Xileriso xo aka ngalava emahlweni ka Ndhambi
outcome.answer: Mahungu lama tsakisaka ya n’wana la vuriwaka Isaka

verse: And inform them about the guests of Abraham, (15:51)
